text: What changes? What was observed? What was not measured? What follows? The proposed update extends the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry as a prerequisite before any broader rollout. A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed a reduction of eighteen percent in origin requests; however, it did not measure stale-read incidence. The reduction is therefore an observed result, not an established overall result.
